void-black.$description: Void Black — Page canvas — the base background across all sections

surface-black.$description: Surface Black — Section surfaces and image containment backgrounds, barely distinguishable from canvas to keep elevation flat

charcoal-hairline.$description: Charcoal Hairline — Structural dividers and borders — the only mid-tone in the system, carrying 900 occurrences as the skeleton between sections and elements

bone-white.$description: Bone White — Primary text, nav labels, project titles, and 1px pill-button borders — the sole signal of interactivity

ash-gray.$description: Ash Gray — Muted helper text and secondary metadata in footer and supporting copy — recedes against the void

opx-medium.$description: Primary brand display and text face — a single weight (400) scaling across body, nav, subheadings, and monumental display. Custom face with a humanist-geometric tension; the anti-convention of using weight 400 (not bold) at 111px display size lets the headline dominate through scale alone rather than visual weight

open-sans.$description: Secondary supporting copy — used in hero subtext and longer descriptive passages where a more relaxed, open-licensed humanist is desired

untitled.$description: Small label text for pill buttons and tag-like links (e.g. "View case study") — the only weight-500 usage in the system, giving micro-UI slightly more presence

helvetica.$description: System fallback for incidental body text and metadata
